A '''tooka doll''' was a squeaky, stuffed doll, with one being owned by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl [[Numa/Legends|Numa]]. It was modeled after the [[Tooka/Legends|tooka]] species.

==History==
The doll was lost once by Numa in the shelter under their home after following a "[[Separatist probe droid/Legends|bright-eye]]"; when her parents found it there, her [[Numa's father/Legends|father]] scolded her.

It was left in the deserted home and found by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] and [[Boil/Legends|Boil]] when they followed [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] back to her home during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. Upon seeing the doll, she began crying, reminded of her lost family.

Pictured on the [[Halo/Legends|''Halo'']] was an image of a tattered tooka doll holding a knife, with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text reading, "Nice Playin' With Ya".
